list.name: Jennifer & Mark L.
list.text: They gutted our master bath and rebuilt it from the floor up. The tile work alone was worth writing a review for — perfectly laid, not a single lippage issue. We've had contractors before who left us with grout cracking in six months. This looks as good today as the day they finished.

list.name: Robert C.
list.text: Kitchen remodel start to finish, on time and within $200 of the estimate. They found a plumbing issue behind the wall that could have been a nightmare — called us before touching it, gave us options. That's the kind of crew you want in your house.

list.name: Susan T.
list.text: We converted an old tub/shower combo into a walk-in shower for my husband. The custom tile work is stunning. They kept the house clean every single day — I kept expecting a mess and it never came. Couldn't recommend more highly.
